title: Autonomous Shuttle Operated by Grab Reportedly Nearly Struck a Schoolgirl at a Crossing in Punggol, Singapore
summary: A Grab-operated autonomous shuttle reportedly came close to a schoolgirl crossing a road in Punggol, Singapore. The transport regulator said the vehicle had tracked the pedestrians and begun braking and steering away before a safety operator took control. Grab was directed to pause testing at such junctions pending investigation. The vehicle was testing a route for an on-demand service.
